llc.formation_notes: SOS fee schedule lists $180 for LLC original filings; expedite $100 (about 3 working days), same-day $150. An Initial Report ($10 if filed separately) is due after formation. A separate DOR Business License Application (UBI) is required if gross income is $12,000/yr or more, among other triggers; its fee varies.

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: by the end of the LLC's anniversary (expiration) month

state_tax_on_llc.name: Business & Occupation (B&O) tax, Service & other activities
state_tax_on_llc.applies: gross receipts of any business (LLC, sole proprietor, S corp) earning service income in WA; 1.5% if prior-year gross under $1,000,000, 1.75% for $1M-$4,999,999, 2.1% for $5M+
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Gross receipts tax, no deduction for expenses. Retailing 0.471%, wholesaling/manufacturing 0.484%. Small Business B&O Credit: for mostly-service businesses the credit fully offsets tax up to $160/month of filing period ($1,920/yr for annual filers) and phases out at twice that ($3,840/yr), so an annual service filer owes nothing up to roughly $128,000 of gross receipts at 1.5%. DOR may relieve a business from filing returns if B&O-taxable gross income is under $125,000/yr and it owes no other tax.

entity_level_taxes.name: B&O tax on gross receipts (same as any business)
entity_level_taxes.notes: No state income tax, so the S election has no state income-tax effect; the S corp pays B&O on gross receipts (1.5% / 1.75% / 2.1% service tiers) with the small business credit.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: Capital gains excise tax (individuals): 7% on Washington long-term capital gains above the standard deduction ($278,000 in 2025, indexed) plus 2.9% on gains above $1,000,000 (since 2025). Real estate and depreciable business assets exempt; sale of a qualified family-owned small business deductible. New 9.9% income tax on AGI over $1 million starts Jan. 1, 2028 (SB 6346, 2026 session).

estimated_tax.required_if: no state individual income tax; no estimated tax
estimated_tax.notes: B&O/excise returns: monthly due the 25th of the following month; quarterly due the last day of the month after the quarter; annual filers due April 15 of the following year (RCW 82.32.045).

unemployment_2026.notes: Up from $72,800 in 2025. New-employer rate is industry-based (commonly cited 115% of industry average) and not verified on esd.wa.gov.

local_taxes.name: Business license tax (city B&O), Service & other business activities
local_taxes.applies: businesses with Seattle taxable revenue of $2,000,000 or more (2026-2032 rate; retail/wholesale/manufacturing 0.342%); a $2M standard deduction applies above the threshold
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: From 2026 no tax if Seattle taxable revenue under $2 million, but a return must still be filed. Annual business license tax certificate fee 2026: $73 (revenue $0-$19,999), $147 ($20,000-$499,999), $667 ($500,000-$1,999,999); exempt from the certificate if Seattle gross income is $4,000 or less and no place of business in the city.

local_taxes.applies: about 50 cities levy their own gross-receipts B&O tax with varying rates and thresholds

notable: No personal income tax in 2026, but B&O tax is charged on gross receipts (1.5% for service businesses under $1M; 1.75% from $1M, 2.1% from $5M) (https://dor.wa.gov/taxes-rates/business-occupation-tax/business-occupation-tax-classifications)
Small Business B&O Credit wipes out the tax for service businesses owing under $1,920/yr, roughly $128,000 gross at 1.5% (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=82.04.4451)
Washington will tax AGI over $1 million at 9.9% starting 2028 (SB 6346) (https://dor.wa.gov/taxes-rates/income-tax)

Seattle raised its B&O threshold from $100,000 to $2 million in 2026 while raising rates (service 0.658%) (https://seattle.gov/city-finance/business-taxes-and-licenses/business-taxes/seattle-shield-bando-tax-changes)
Business license required once gross income reaches $12,000/yr (https://dor.wa.gov/open-business/apply-business-license)
Capital gains tax 7% + 2.9% over $1M can hit the sale of a business interest (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=82.87.040)
